moments.text: Infrared view from above over desert scrub: a small dark object sits just right of the green crosshair.
After a black flicker the view zooms in for 1.5 s: a dark round blob with a ragged tail hanging below, right of the crosshair.
After another black flicker the view zooms in and stays close: the dark cluster with its hanging tail drifts over desert and fence lines.
The object, now mid-grey, drifts past huts, walls, vehicles and trees, rarely centred; at 4:46 it slides out of the top of the frame.
After a white flash the view jumps wide over the base; the object returns as a small grey cluster just right of the crosshair.
Brief zoom-in between a black and a white flash: the grey cluster sits right of the crosshair while a dark mound slides past.
The view zooms in again over village rooftops and fields; the cluster, grey then dark, drifts near the crosshair.
View widens over a broad smooth surface edged by a bright shoreline; the object is a tiny dark dot below the crosshair.
Zoomed in again: the dark cluster with its tail hangs near the crosshair against a grainy grey background.
After one striped frame the display polarity flips: the object turns white. From 15:06 the scene goes very dark with bright patches.
Normal contrast returns: the white object sits just below and right of the crosshair over grey ground crossed by a dark band.
View jumps wide after a black flicker: the object is a small white dot right of the crosshair, fading among bright patches near the end.
